title: pocket fan
text: pocket fan. These are the perfect 'hot flash' fans.  I used one for years - and purchased this one for my daughter who is beginning to feel those - it's larger than the one I had used, however, it works really well and has foam blades so it is safer than mine with the plastic blades.  It seems an odd thing - but it is helpful when needed! Having said this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
